response.text: Article 15 of the GDPR gives a data subject the right to obtain from a controller confirmation whether their personal data are being processed and, where that is the case, access to the personal data and specified information about the processing (e.g., purposes, categories of data, recipients, retention period, legal basis, source of the data, and the existence of automated decision‑making including profiling). It also entitles the data subject to receive a copy of their personal data (the first copy being free, additional copies may be subject to a reasonable fee) and states that this right must not adversely affect the rights and freedoms of others. ([eur-lex.europa.eu](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/?qid=1494678401079&uri=CELEX%3A32016R0679&utm_source=openai))
